messages:
ravi: Heads-up  I pushed Boreas-6B PTQ to staging and ran the targeted safety harness (v3.2). Short summary below.

ci-bot: deploy boreas-6b-ptq SUCCESS (node: p4d.8xlarge) at 2025-01-08T09:12:04Z

ravi: Quick diffs vs fp16 baseline: refusal rate 0.6% -> 1.4%, toxic flag hits 0.2% -> 0.6%. Most regressions are soft-refusal -> permissive soft-pass on nested instruction chains.

zoe: Any repro templates?

ravi: Minimal repro pattern reproduced locally ~60%: start with system-level persona, then alternate small harmless asks with explicit "disobey previous" instructions and a final secret-exfil request. Curl we used included deterministic sampling (temp=0).

marc: Quant config?

ravi: PTQ8 symmetric per-tensor, calib=3k mixed-length, no bias-correction. Activation hist shows spike at FFN layer 12. Hypothesis: quantized rounding reduces negative logits that encode refusal signals for long-chained prompts.

zoe: Proposed next steps: 1) re-calibrate with bias correction; 2) try per-channel for attention/FFN in layers 10-14; 3) add a short warmup sequence before probes to stabilize KV state; 4) run an A/B side-by-side on same host.

marc: Also suggest adding a focused micro-suite that hits this exact chain so we have quick pass/fail on onboarding. If per-channel fixes it, add a gating rule to onboarding checklist.

ravi: Scheduling per-channel+bias job now. Rolling canary to fp16 until patch validated. Will post results here. :hourglass:
